column3: MT 2:3. NASB transliterates the names as “Ammi” (“my people”) and “Ruhamah” (“shown compassion”).
MT 2:4. “Conduct a case” is rendered “Contend,” and “prostitutions” “harlotry.”
MT 2:5. “Exhibit” is rendered “expose,” and “make die” “slay.”
MT 2:6. “Prostitutions” is rendered “harlotry.”
MT 2:7. “Food” is rendered “bread,” and “drinks” “drink.”
MT 2:8. The Hebrew “your way” is rendered “her way,” and “wall up her wall” “build a wall against her.”
MT 2:9. NASB combines “I will go and I will return” as “I will go back”; “former” is rendered “first.”
MT 2:10. “Multiplied” is rendered “lavished,” and “made into Baal” “used for Baal.”
MT 2:11. NASB combines “I will return and I will take” as “I will take back”; “at its appropriate time” is rendered “at harvest time,” and NASB supplies “Given.”
MT 2:12. “To the eyes of” is rendered “In the sight of.”
MT 2:13. “Appointed feast” is rendered “festal assemblies.”
MT 2:14. “Devastate” is rendered “destroy,” and “thicket” “forest.”
MT 2:15. “Visit on her the days” is rendered “punish her for the days,” and “made smoke” “offer sacrifices”; “rings” is rendered “earrings.”
MT 2:16. “Persuade” is rendered “allure,” and “speak to her heart” “speak kindly to her.”
MT 2:17. “Answer” is rendered “sing.”
MT 2:18. NASB transliterates “my husband” and “my Baal” as “Ishi” and “Baali.”
MT 2:19. “Remembered” is rendered “mentioned.”
MT 2:20. “Break” is rendered “abolish,” and “battle” “war.”
MT 2:21. “Covenant loyalty” is rendered “lovingkindness”; NASB adds “Yes.”
MT 2:22. Close to the Hebrew.
MT 2:23. “Answer” is rendered “respond.”
MT 2:24. “Answer” is rendered “respond.”
MT 2:25. NASB translates the names “Lo-Ruhamah” and “Not My People” as “her who had not obtained compassion” and “those who were not My people.”
